Xerath.summary: Dominate levels 1-3 by pushing and poking him into his turret. Winning the lane requires sharp movement to dodge his stun and poke.

Annie.summary: Bully her from levels 1-3 and shove her under turret. At level 6 expect her to Flash-ult you, so respect that threat.

Cassiopeia.summary: If you dodge her Q you win the trade; if it hits, you lose badly.

Irelia.summary: Her passive takes away your early edge, and your short range puts you in her Q range when you auto. Back off when her passive is stacked; take Teleport and farm toward late game.

Nocturne.summary: As a constant pusher you are an easy target for an enemy Nocturne from level 6. Dominate lane before 6, then play safe or roam.

Syndra.summary: Bully her at levels 1-3 and push her into her turret, then rely on good movement to dodge her stun and poke.

Viktor.summary: He is strong but you should dominate the early levels. Build a lead and use it to roam if he becomes too strong in lane.

Orianna.summary: Her Q zones you so you cannot really poke her. Take Teleport and farm toward late game.

Katarina.summary: An aggressive Katarina can kill you, so stay aware of where her daggers land and use E to reposition away from them.

Hecarim.summary: If he sees you shoving hard he can punish you; place deep wards and track him.

Heimerdinger.summary: You can hit his turrets from outside their range. Sit back, farm and punish his mistakes.

Akali.summary: Not a problem; your W reveals her inside her shroud. When she ults you, expect her to land behind you.

Lissandra.summary: She lanes poorly and often gets camped by her jungler, so be careful; Cleanse is an option. If she E's toward you, expect her jungler nearby.

Yasuo.summary: Hold your passive double-shot autos while his shield is up, and use your dash to reposition away from it.

Malzahar.summary: Your Q clears his voidlings at once and your W removes his passive shield. The only downside is that his Q cancels your ult.
